data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 15.6 million in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: release of GBP 8.8 million). The release of prior year reserves was split GBP 9.2 million reinsurance and GBP 6.4 million insurance lines of business.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 reported a gross release of GBP 6.4 million in prior year claims reserves for the 2013 and prior years of account, driven by favourable claims development. This contributed to a net release of GBP 15.6 million after reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: release of GBP 15.6 million of reserves held at 31 December 2014
release of prior year reserves was split GBP 9.2 million reinsurance and GBP 6.4 million insurance lines of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure is explicitly stated for 'insurance lines of business'. No claims development triangle was found. One line of business in the gross premium mix ('Motor (other classes)') shows a negative amount for gross premiums written, which has been included as reported.
